message.content:
This is the **world creation / setup screen** (a sub-menu of the title menu, specifically for configuring a new world before generating it).

**Brief description:**  
The screen displays the heading **"CREATE NEW WORLD"** and includes input fields for the world **Name** ("New World") and **Seed** (a long number). Below are buttons to select **Game Mode** (Survival), **World Type** (Normal), a **"Create World"** button (with modifiers like "Depleting Stacks, Real Damage, Respawn"), and a **Cancel** button. The background shows a dark, reddish, pixelated landscape. This is where players configure settings *before* the game generates/loads the actual world.
